study.title: Banglapapers
study.oneLiner: A context engine for news: stories from mainstream newspapers, social media and the wider internet, grouped by topic and ranked so the most important and latest gist comes first.

problem.context: The same story is reported by many newspapers and discussed across social media at once. Reading it means visiting each source and working out which version matters and which is newest.

steps: collect from newspapers, social media and the web
group reports on the same topic
show the gist, with every source behind it
